mapper.sql: id, goods_name, goods_title, goods_img, goods_detail, goods_price, seckill_price, stock_count, start_date, end_date
mapper.select: select from seckill_goods order by start_date asc
mapper.update: update seckill_goods set stock_count = stock_count - 1 where id = #{id} and stock_count > 0
mapper.insert: insert into seckill_goods (goods_name, goods_title, goods_img, goods_detail, goods_price, seckill_price, stock_count, start_date, end_date) values (#{goodsName}, #{goodsTitle}, #{goodsImg}, #{goodsDetail}, #{goodsPrice}, #{seckillPrice}, #{stockCount}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
